column5: say it once and keep typing. juno sets the reminder and shows you the card so you know it took. then it folds back into a dot. mac app, junebug.ai
no switching to the calendar. ask how long you've got, the dot grows into the answer, and it's gone again before your next sentence. mac app, junebug.ai
the draft was already in mail. you say who it goes to and what to ask. juno finds it and sends it, then shows you what went out. built with tauri, junebug.ai
